name.en: Recorded “Revolut” call threatening to report you to the police

how.en: A call from a Maltese number plays a recorded message in English that says it is Revolut and that your personal details don’t match. It threatens to report you to the police unless you give your details. A second caller then asks for your account codes and personal information. People who went along with it had their accounts emptied, sometimes within hours.

text.en: A Maltese number calls and a recording says it is Revolut.
It says there is a problem with your personal details and threatens a police report.
A live caller asks for your account codes and personal details.
Money is taken from your account soon after.

Automated message: Hello, this is Revolut. We found a mismatch in the information on your account. If you do not verify your identity now, this case will be passed to the police. Press 1 to speak to an agent.

en: Revolut said my details don't match
threatened to report me to the police
second caller asked for my codes
Revolut account emptied after a call
A bank or payment app threatening you with the police.
Being asked for codes or personal details on a call you didn’t expect.
A recorded message that hands you over to a “colleague”.
Hang up and block the number. Check your account only in the Revolut app.
Never share codes or personal details with someone who called you.
If you lost money, keep screenshots, the number and your transactions, tell Revolut at once and report it to the Police, even if you lost nothing.
